ITEM TEXT
One
of
the
complex
agricultural
problems
is
the
issue
of
food
waste
.
Food
waste
refers
to
the
discarding
of
edible
food
at
various
stages
of
the
food
supply
chain
,
from
production
to
consumption
.
This
not
only
represents
a
significant
loss
of
resources
but
also
has
environmental
implications
,
such
as
greenhouse
gas
emissions
from
decomposing
food
waste
in
landfills
.
